input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (appropriate given Vendor processes our health data), and workers' compensation as required by law, all maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primacy over Customer's insurance, notice of cancellation, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. The obligations bind the Vendor and favour us, so no redline is warranted.
